title: Schedule of Charges of the Equity Desk: Transfer Permissions, Eligible Transferees and Recording Fees by Equity Class
content:
Equity held under Membership and Patronage Equity may be signed over only on the classes marked below, only to a transferee of a class listed against it, and on payment of the recording fee shown.

| Class | Equity may be signed over | Board approval required | Transferees the class admits | Recording fee, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Associate Patron Account | no | yes | not applicable | 0.00 |
| Class A Voting Membership | yes | yes | immediate family member; farming entity of the member | 50.00 |
| Class B Preferred Equity Membership | yes | yes | immediate family member; farming entity of the member; another voting member | 50.00 |
| Retained Patronage Certificate Holding | yes | yes | immediate family member; farming entity of the member | 50.00 |
| Age Retirement Equity Membership | yes | yes | immediate family member; farming entity of the member | 50.00 |
| Estate Retirement Equity Holding | yes | yes | estate of the member; surviving spouse | 0.00 |

Five of the six classes admit a transfer and one does not. Every class requires the board's approval before a transfer is recorded, including the class on which no transfer is admitted at all.

The recording fee is 50.00 on four classes and 0.00 on the two remaining ones.

**On the transferees.** Only one class admits another voting member as a transferee. Only one class admits the estate of the member and a surviving spouse, and that class admits no other. The remaining three transferring classes admit an immediate family member and a farming entity of the member and no one else.

**Points of judgement.** A member holding the Class A Voting Membership who wishes to sign equity over to another voting member is naming a transferee that class does not list; the same transferee is listed on the Class B Preferred Equity Membership. A member holding the Associate Patron Account is on the one class whose transfer column reads no.
